findings.title: The QA service is published with the ABS modernization description
findings.quality_lens: A core QA offering is described with unrelated banking-system modernization copy.
findings.system_lens: Service cards and detail routes appear to lack typed content ownership and duplication validation.
findings.business_lens: A prospect evaluating Bell Integrator's QA expertise may infer weak release controls from the QA storefront itself.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm the copy and card-to-route mapping in settled desktop and mobile renders.

findings.title: Corporate age and office footprint are inconsistent across the current domain
findings.quality_lens: The same domain presents 7 offices or representatives and 9 representatives, while a fixed 20-year claim conflicts with a 2003 founding date in 2026.
findings.system_lens: Corporate facts are duplicated across templates instead of governed through a shared source with freshness rules.
findings.business_lens: Candidates and clients receive inconsistent scale and maturity signals during due diligence.
findings.promotion_rule: Human review must confirm intended definitions of office and representative office before final severity.

findings.title: The careers page contains stale time-relative stories and visible editorial defects
findings.quality_lens: Candidate-facing content contains stale duration claims and visible grammar or spelling errors.
findings.system_lens: Long-lived career content lacks date-aware rendering and an editorial acceptance gate.
findings.business_lens: The employer-brand page can reduce confidence among senior candidates evaluating the company's delivery culture.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm rendered visibility and distinguish archived storytelling from intentionally current copy.

findings.title: Current engineering vacancies contain candidate-facing copy defects
findings.quality_lens: Senior technical vacancies expose spacing, inflection, and spelling defects.
findings.system_lens: Vacancy publishing lacks automated language checks and role-template acceptance criteria.
findings.business_lens: Editorial defects weaken perceived process quality at the exact point where the company evaluates senior specialists.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm both vacancies remain active and the text is visible in desktop and mobile views.
